adjustment_bridge.mechanical_boundary: No group equity-method income, subsidy, disposal, impairment or other one-off was allocated. Zero means no permitted amount was assigned, not proof that no group item existed.

cells.capital_burden_observation: COMPONENTS_MIXED: capex and depreciation/amortization increased while impairment burden declined; all three required reported inputs are present.
cells.product_unit_economics: UNKNOWN: the annual report does not disclose a core deep-processing product's recurring unit profit after persistent R&D, selling, administrative and capital burden. This does not erase the observable reportable-segment bridge.

first_match_trace.reason: Comparable reportable-segment revenue/profit, all three frozen product sales volumes, external main-business gross margin and all three capital-burden inputs are disclosed. Missing product-level full unit economics is handled by a later class and is not a required input in this first condition.

The report identifies the reportable segment consistently and separately explains that other business-section presentations include headquarters; this settlement uses the reportable-segment table on both the frozen and outcome boundaries.
Adjusted recurring segment profit increased only 4.17%, external main-business gross margin was 26.37%, and product-level recurring unit economics was not disclosed.
The at-least-10% profit-growth and at-least-27.73% gross-margin conditions both failed.
Adjusted recurring segment profit did not fall, gross margin remained above 24.70%, and none of the three core product sales volumes fell more than 10%.
Profit was within the FY2023 plus-or-minus-5% band, but external main-business gross margin of 26.37% was below the required 27.73%-29.73% interval.

All classification inputs are observable and comparable, but the combination of +4.17% recurring segment profit, 26.37% gross margin, positive volumes and mixed capital-burden components satisfies none of the earlier numerical classes.

localized_unknowns: Core-product recurring unit economics after persistent R&D, selling, administrative and capital burden is not disclosed.

rare_earth.boundary_note: The report states that the original Jinlong rare-earth smelting/separation business was transferred and no longer consolidated. The transfer consideration is disclosed, but the transaction-specific disposal gain and a post-transfer-perimeter FY2023 restatement are not.

first_match_trace.reason: The condition requires no known un-restatable responsibility-boundary or definition conflict. Here the report explicitly identifies a rare-earth perimeter change, so the missing rare-earth disposal-gain amount is retained as a local unknown but this first class does not match.

The original Jinlong rare-earth smelting/separation business was transferred and no longer consolidated. The annual report provides neither the transaction-specific disposal gain needed to reconstruct rare-earth adjusted recurring segment profit nor a FY2023 restatement to the post-transfer perimeter. Battery materials remains separately observed and is not erased by this rare-earth-local mismatch.

localized_unknowns: Rare-earth transaction-specific disposal gain within the group disposal-gain total is UNKNOWN.
Rare-earth FY2023 profit, revenue and oxide-volume restatement to the post-transfer FY2024 perimeter is UNKNOWN.
Rare-earth adjusted recurring segment profit and the two-segment adjusted recurring aggregate are therefore UNKNOWN; battery-materials reported and adjusted bridge remains separately observable.

parent_cash_bridge.boundary_note: Observed parent investment cash receipts and the absence of a disclosed group-asset/debt restriction do not close subsidiary post-capex cash, NCI, required-retention and net-parent-support reconciliation. Disposal, borrowing and capital return are not counted.

first_match_trace.reason: Consolidated OCF, cash capital expenditure and all comparable debt components are disclosed. The open NCI/parent bridge is explicitly not sufficient for this class.
The authorized report supplies comparable FY2024/FY2023 consolidated cash-flow and debt line items; no disclosed cash-flow classification or debt-definition conflict prevents the frozen calculations.
No legal, regulatory, minority-shareholder agreement or financing-contract evidence explicitly blocks upstream cash for at least 12 months. UNKNOWN parent access does not trigger this class.
FY2024 group cash proxy is positive CNY984.23m, the two-year proxy is positive CNY3.166bn, and comparable debt declined rather than increasing at least 15%.

Although FY2024 and two-year group cash proxies pass the numerical thresholds and parent investment cash receipts are observed, subsidiary post-capex cash, NCI allocation, required retention/reinvestment, recurring upstream receipts by subsidiary and net parent support are not reconciled; parent distributable owner cash remains UNKNOWN.
FY2024 group cash proxy is non-negative and the two-year sum is positive, no severe condition matches, while NCI scope and the four-step parent distributable owner-cash bridge remain open.

localized_unknowns: Material non-wholly-owned subsidiary post-capex cash is UNKNOWN because subsidiary-level capex is not disclosed with the disclosed subsidiary OCF.
Required subsidiary retention/reinvestment and recurring parent upstream receipts reconciled by subsidiary are UNKNOWN.
Net parent cash support and parent distributable owner cash are UNKNOWN.
These parent/NCI unknowns do not erase the observed positive FY2024 or two-year consolidated group cash proxy.
